brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: Single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: Build has one piece: piece:0,0,0;half-n at 0,0,0. No other pieces beside or above.

Configurator only offers one drawer socket per half-base cut face (s slot on half-n). Currently 1 drawer fitted (drawer:0#0,0#cut). find_sockets for drawer returns 0 additional sockets; attempts to add extra drawers on same face return ALREADY_FITTED. Five drawers on a single base is not supported by the socket rules.

finish.summary: Single half-n base satisfies the single-base constraint but the configurator only allows one drawer per cut face, so five drawers cannot be fitted. Build left with 1 drawer; requirement reported as unmet.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
